tei:div.tei:p: chos rgyal 'phags pa'i shes bya rab gsal las/ snod bcud kyi chags tshul mdor bsdus pa bzhugs so/

oṃ swa ti/ bsam 'phel bla ma kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras/ /smra ba'i seng ge 'jam dbyangs zhabs btud nas/ /de'i rnam 'phrul chos rgyal 'phags pa yis| |mdo rgyud don bsdus shes bya'i gnas rnams kun/ /rab tu gsal byed bstan bca ོ sa brtsams pa las/ /mdor tsam bsdus pa 'di dag bdag gi bri// dang po rdul grangs 'gyur khyed rtsi ba ni/ /bcang bzung gcig tu med pa phra rab rdul| |bdun 'gyur rdul phran lcags chu ri bong lug /glang rdul nyi zer sro ma shig nas rdul/ /de bzhin re re bzhin du bdun 'gyur te/ /nas bdun sor tshigs bcu gnyis mtho gang la/ /mtho do 'khru gang 'khru bzhi 'dom pa gang*/ /de dag lnga brgya rgyang grags de brgyad la/ /dpag tshad gcig tu rtsi ba rab gsal lugs | | snod kyi chags tshul dang po stong pa la/ /phyogs bcu'i rlung g.yos dkyil 'khor rgya gram gyi/ /rngam su dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu drug dang*/ /rgya khyon grangs med de yis brten pa'i steng*/ /chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po mthug rngam la/ /chig 'bum rags chen thad kar sa ya gcig /gnyis 'bum gsum stong brgya phrag phyed dang lnga/ /de dag 'og gi rgya mtsho brgyad ldan chu/ /de srub spris ma gser gyi sa gzhi ni/ /rngam su dpag tshad gsum 'bum gnyis khri dang*// thad ka'i tshad ni 'og gi tshad dang mnyam/ /gnyis ka'i mthas skor thad la gsum 'gyur ro/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor mi mjed 'jig rten khams/ /sa chu'i dkyil 'khor gling bzhi ri rab gdan/ /gser gyi sa steng char phab rgya mtshor gyur | | rlung gis bsrubs pa'i khams rab 'dus ri rab/ /'bring 'dus pa la gser gyi ri bdun dang*/ /tha ma'i lcags ri sna tshogs 'dus pa'i gling*/ /rim par chags zhing lhun po'i shar phyogs dngul/ /lho bai ḍū r+ya nub la shel dmar po//byang phyogs gser dang ri bdun gser 'ba' zhig /gling bzhi gling phran dang brgyad phal cher pa/

/'khor yug lcags ri lcags la ri rab gyi/ / dpangs la dpag tshad dag ni chig 'bum dang*/ /drug khri yod pa mtsho 'tsham yar mar phyed//ri bdun mtho shos gnya' shing 'dzin gyi dpangs/ /dpag tshad bzhi khri de nas shol mda' 'dzin/ /seng ldeng 'dzin dang rta sna sdug ri dang*/ /rta sna rnam bdud mu khyud 'dzin rnams la/ /rim bzhin phyed mar phyi ma lcags 'arigs spangasaklaris dpangasablu/ /dpag tshad sum brgya phyed dang bcu gsum yod/ /thad ka'i tshad rnams dpangs dang mnyam pa'o/ /ri bdun bar gyi mtsho bdun kha zheng la/ / nang ma dpag tshad brgyad khri de'i phyi mar/ /rim bzhin phyed 'phri ri rab ri bdun po| |mtshor bcas gru bzhi lcags ri sgor mor gnas/ /mu khyud 'dzin dang lcags ri bar gyi tshad/ /dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri nyis stong yod/ /lcags ri'i nang na ba tsha can gyi mtsho/ /mtsho gcig rgya mtsho chen po bzhir grags pa/ / na po'i phyogs bzhi'i ngos kyi kha dog bzhin/ /mtsho dang gling rnams de dang mthun pa'i phyir/ /rgya mtsho de'i mtha' skor dpag tshad ni/ /sa ya phrag gsum drug 'bum bdun brgya dang*/ /lnga cu yod cing de'i phyi rol gyi/ / khor yug lcags ri mtha' skor sa ya gsum/ /drug 'bum nyis stong drug brgya nyer lnga yod/ /ri rab lho phyogs 'dzam gling shing rta'i dbyibs/ /sog kha'i yu ba chu ngos bstan pa la/ / dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi gzhan phyogs gsum la/ /stong phrag gnyis gnyis shar na rnga yab dang*/ /nub na rnga yab gzhan yod 'dzam gling dbus/ /ma ga ta nas byang du ri nag po/ /dgur rgyud gangs ri spos ngad de'i phyir/ /spaus ri ngad ldan de gnyis bar gyi mtsho/ /ma draus gru bzhi zab dang ngos de'i tshad/ /dpag tshad lnga cu re re de'i chu/ /gtsang dang 'jam dang snyog ma med mngar dang*/ /dri zhim mgrin pa lto la mi gnod pa/ /yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu yin no/ /de la chu bo bzhi 'babs si ta dang*/

/gaṅgā sin+dhu pak+ṣu zhes pa'o// ma dros rtsa ba'i brag gi bya skyibs na/ /'dzam bu tri sha'i dpag bsam sdong bu las | | 'bras bu cher smin mtsho nang lhung ba'i sgra/ /'dzam bu zhes bya'i mtshon pas 'dzam gling grags/ /shar gyi lus 'phags gling ni zla gam la/ /ri rab ngos bstan spyad kha dpag tshad ni/ /gsum brgya lnga cu grangs gzhan gsum drug re| |byang na lus dang lho na lus 'phags yod/ /de gsum gling gzhan rnams las rta la bdun/ / gyen du 'phags dang mi rnams gzugs bzang bas/ /lus 'phags po zhes grags pa de nas yin/ /byang na sgra mi snyan ni gru bzhi la/ /ngos rer dpag tshad nyis stong nub phyogs na/ sgra mi snyan dang shar na de'i zla ba/ / shing dang sha za'i skad kyis zhag bdun nas/ /'chi 'pho sgra 'byung de phyir sgra mi snyan | | nub kyi ba glang spyod ni zlum po yin/ /mtha' skor dag la dpag tshad bdun stong dang*/ /lnga brgya yod cing lho na g.yo ldan dang*/ /byang na lam mchog 'gro yod de'i ming*/ /phal cher ba glang rin chen longs spyod pas/ /ba glang spyod zhes grags pa de'i phyir/ /ri bdun gling rnams ri bo thams cad kyang*/ /ri rab dang mtshung mthur du brgyad khri zug /ri rab mtsho steng yan la bang rim bzhi/ / 'og ma'i ngos der dpag tshad khri drug stong*/ /gong ma'i rim bzhin phyed de zhum pa'o/ /steng phyogs dpag tshad bzhi khri me shel la'ang*/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor thad kar dpag tshad grangs/ /lnga cu rtsa gcig mtha' skor chig brgya dang*/ /lnga cu rtsa gsum dpangs la dpag tshad drug /bco brgyad cha gcig yod pa bar snang gnas | |mthug rngam de bzhin chu shel las grub pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor thad kar lnga cu dang*/ /mtha' skor dpag tshad phyed dang nyi brgya'o/ /skar ma rin chen sna tshogs las grub mang*/ /zlum po chung tshad rgyang grags gcig dang ni/ /'bring gsum che ba la drug mtha' skor la/ /rang rang thad ka'i gsum 'gyur dag tu 'dod|

|'di nas dpag tshad lnga yan ri rab kyi/ /rtse man gnas shing grangs ka dung 'phyur gnyis/ /bye ba phrag brgyad sa ya lnga ru bzhed/ /bcud kyi sems can smin tshul stong gsum 'di/ /bskal ba mes bshig rjes la 'od gsal gyi// lha nas rim gyi tshe 'phos tshang ris slebs/ /'jig rten spyi las tshangs pa bya ba byung*| |de ni lha nas rim rgyud sgra mi snyan/ /ba glang spyod dang lus 'phags 'dzam gling skyes/ /dur 'gro yid dwags dmyal ba mthar thug te/ dmyal ba zhes bya 'dzam gling 'dis 'og tu/ /dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu gru bzhir gnas/ /yi dwags gnas pa rgyal po'i khab kyi 'og /dpag tshad lnga brgyar grong khyer ser skya na| |yi dgas gtso bo gshin rje chos rgyal yod/ /dud 'gro phal cher phyi'i rgya mtshor gnas/ kha 'thor ba rnams lha mi'i yul na'ang yod/ /mi rnams gling bzhi gling g.yog brgyad po dang*/ /gser gling la sogs gling phran gzhan na'ang gnas| |lha min gnas pa ri rab mtshor bying ba'i/ khong seng la yod mthur la rim pa bzhin/ /gnas bzang chang gi ltung ba med pa tsam/ /ma rtogs lha dang lo ngo mnyam 'drar bshad/ khams gsum sems can dbye ba 'di lta te/ /mnar med dmyal ba yi dgas dud 'gro dang*/ /mi dang lha min 'dod pa'i lha drug man| |'khrig pa zas nor chags pas 'dod khams zer/ /lha drug 'og ma rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i 'khor/ /ri rab bang rim dang por gzhong thogs dang*/ / gnyis par 'phreng thogs gsum par stag nyos gnas/ /bzhi pa'i lha dang gnya' shing 'dzin ri yi/ /shar phyogs yul 'khor srung na yul 'khor srung/ /byang phyogs lcang lo can na rnam thos sras/ /nub phyogs sna tshogs gzugs na mig mi bzang | | lho phyogs 'phags skyes po na 'phags skyes rgyal/ /nyi zla skar ma lcags ri 'dzam gling gi /ri dang ljon shing la gnas lha tshogs rnams/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhir char stong sde tshan gcig /der rting ri rab zur bzhi'i lcog de la

| | 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang lnga de 'phags/ /chu zheng brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga re/ /mtha' skor dpag tshad lnga brgyas skor ba na/ /gnod sbyin gsang ba pa rnams gnas par bshad/ /de'i dbus na sum cu rtsa gsum ni/ /gser las grub pa'i grong khyer lta na sdug /dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis 'phags ngos re la/ / nyis stong lnga brgya mtha' ma khri'i 'khor ba'i/ /lcags ri dang bcas de dbus lha'i gnas/ /rnam rgyal khang bzangs gru bzhi gyen phyogs la/ dpag tshad phyed dang lnga 'phags ngos re la/ /nyi brgya lnga cu re yod de dag na/ /nor lha mched brgyad drag po bcu gcig dang*/ /nyi ma bcu gnyis mtha' skar bu gnyis te/ / dbang po nyer dbang sum cu rtsa gsum dag /yod phyir lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum zer/ /rgya byin btsun mo'i sde sogs lha dbang ni/ /lha min bu mo rnams dang rnam par rol/ /de steng dpag tshad brgyad khri 'thab bral gnas/ /tshad ni ri rab ngos las nyis 'gyur che/ /de yan 'thab rtsod dang bral 'thab bral zhes/ / de nas dpag tshad drug khri 'phags pa na/ /dga' ldan lha gnas 'thab bral gnyis 'gyur che/ /byams mgon theg chen skyong bas dga' ldan zer/ /der steng dpag tshad gsum 'bum nyi khri na/ /'phrul dga'i lha gnas dga' ldan nyis 'gyur che/ /rang gi sprul nas spyod pas 'phrul dga' zer/ /der steng dpag tshad drug 'bum bzhi khri na/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed 'phrul dga'i nyis 'gyur che/ / gzhan gyi sprul pa'i longs spyod dpag med la/ /bde bar spyod pas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed zer/ /de man 'dod pa'i lha drug 'dod khams yin/ /der steng gzugs khams lha rigs bcu bdun ni/ /bsam gtan bzhi'i bsdus dang po tshangs ris dang*/ /'dun na 'don dang tshangs pa chen po'o/ /gnyis pa 'od chung tshad med 'od gsal lo/ /gsum pa dge chung tshad med dge rgyas so/ /bzhi pa dag la rnam pa brgyad du 'byed/ /sprin med bsod nams skyes dang 'bras bu che

| | de man so so skye bo'i gnas gzhan yin/ /mi che mi gdung gya nom snang ba dang | | shin du mtho ba 'og min gnas dang lnga/ /'phags pa'i gnas yin gtsang rigs lha lnga zer/ /bar khyad rgya khyon gnyis 'gyur yar yar che/ /bcu bdun pa de 'dod lha 'dod chags bral/ /gzugs la chags pas gzugs khams pa zhes zer/ /de'i steng na gzugs med lha gnas bzhi/ /lus med ting 'dzin bye brag bzhi 'gyur te/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched rnam shes dang*// ci yang med dang 'du shes med min rnams/ /gzugs med 'dod pa'i 'dod chags bcas pa'i phyir/ /gzugs med khams kyi lha ni bzhi zer ro/ /e ma srid pa'i rtser phyin lha thob kyang*/ /sems kyi gnas lugs ma rtaugs 'khrul ba spyod | | zo chun 'khyud mo ji bzhin 'khor ba rnams/ /dal 'byor thob dus btsan sa 'dzin pa rigs/ /bskal ba dang lo zla zhag dus kyi thung mtha'i skad cig ma la thug te/ de'ang*/ phra ba'i skad gcig ma'i tshad ni/ gyad kyis se gol ga togs pa gcig gi yun nam/ bud med 'bring po'i bal 'dab 'tha ེ na nas 'phang la/ dkris pa'i yun de brgya nyi shur bgos pa'i cha gcig yin par 'dod do | | phra ba'i skad gcig ma de brgya nyi shu la rags pa'i skad gcig go /de drug cu la thang gcig go /de sum cu la yud tsam gcig de sum cu la nyin zhag cigade sum cu la zla ba gcig zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig lo de/ bcu/ brgya/ stong | khri/ 'bum/ sa ya/ bye ba/ dung phyur/ ther 'bum rnams bcu 'gyur yin/ der rting mda' 'o dang bcas pa'i grangs kyi rnam grangs ni dpag tu med te/ mthar thug brjod du med pa'o/ /bskal ba drug zhes pa ni/ bar gyi bskal ba dang | chags pa'i bskal ba dang*/ gnas pa'i bskal ba dang*/ 'jig pa'i bskal ba dang*/ stong pa'i bskal ba dang*/ bskal ba chen po'o/ /bar bskal ces pa ni/ mi lo ther 'bum bcu la ther 'bum chen po gcig yong ba/ de la bar bskal gcig zer te/

de 'dra ba nyi shu'i yun la snod bcud 'jig nyi shu'i yun la stong*/ nyi shu'i yun du chags/ nyi shu'i yun du gnas pa/ bar bskal brgyad bcu po de rdzogs pa la/ bskal ba chen po gcig zer ro/ /dang por chags pa la bar bskal gcig 'gro ba'i tshad ni/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor brtsams pa nas/ dmyal ba mnar med du sems can gcig skyes pa'i bar de yin cing*/'jig pa'i mgo brtsams pa nas/ mnar med du sems can gcig kyang med pa'i dus de'ang*/ bar bskal gcig yin no/ /snod 'jig pa'i tshe mes 'jig pa dang*/ chus 'jig pa dang*/ rlung gis 'jig pa dag gsum las/ mthar rlung gis 'jig pa'i dus su/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i gnas man 'jig te/ rlung chen pos ri rab kyang gtor nas yang du stong la/ gzhan rnams lta mos kyang ci dgos| de ltar du thams cad zhig tshar ba'i rjes la/ phyogs bcu'i rlung 'dus nas| sra zhing brtan pa'i dkyil 'khor chags pa la brten nas/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gser gyi sa bzhi la sogs snod kyi 'jig rten dang*/ bcud kyi sems can sngon ma ltar yar mar/ rim pa bzhin legs par chags so/ /chos rgyal 'phags pas mdo rgyud mtha' dag gis/ khyad par 'phags pa'i don bsdus bstan bcos ming*/ /shes bya rab gsal grags pa'i nyi ma yis /bdag blo'i mun pa gsal phyir snod bcud kyi/ /chags 'jig khams sum dbye ba mdor bsdus 'dis/ /dge bas 'gro rnams kun mkhyen thob par shog/// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/snod bcud kyi chags tshul mdor bsdus/ -PAGE 294--PAGE 301-
